summary: This Form 8-K Item 8.01 filing reports a periodic net asset value (NAV) update: Pearl Diver Credit Company Inc. disclosed its management’s unaudited NAV per common share of $11.17 as of April 30, 2026. The filing is a routine NAV disclosure with no change in corporate structure, transaction, or special situation. No strategic event, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or restructuring is indicated. The registrant is the issuer of common and preferred stock. This is purely a periodic reporting event akin to a routine NAV announcement with no deal terms or event-driven catalyst.
